// Generated by libwasm tools/runtime-adapt.
// Error handling mirrors onAssertErrorMsg: decode D strings from WASM
// linear memory, then abort. Do not swallow exceptions (the previous
// captureException only console.log'd).
//
// Wire these into jsExports.env next to the existing assert import.
// wasm-eh (newest LDC + --wasm-enable-eh -mattr=+exception-handling)
// still calls _d_throw_exception from the LDC frontend (DtoThrow);
// the implementation may be a JS import (today) or a wasm `throw` to
// a tag that JS catches as WebAssembly.Exception.

export function installErrorHandling(env, decoders, abort) {
  const decode = (len, ptr) => {
    if (typeof len === 'string') return len; // old dom-ts ABI
    return decoders.string(len, ptr);
  };

  env.onAssertErrorMsg = (fileLen, filePtr, line, msgLen, msgPtr) => {
    abort('assert', decode(fileLen, filePtr), line, decode(msgLen, msgPtr));
  };

  env.onUnittestErrorMsg = (fileLen, filePtr, line, msgLen, msgPtr) => {
    abort('unittest', decode(fileLen, filePtr), line, decode(msgLen, msgPtr));
  };

  // Current libwasm.rt.stubs._d_throw_exception → captureException(string).
  // Same shape as onAssertErrorMsg (D string = length + ptr).
  env.captureException = (msgLen, msgPtr) => {
    const msg = decode(msgLen, msgPtr);
    abort('exception', '', 0, msg);
  };

  // Newest-LDC wasm-eh leftovers. Keep no-op-or-abort, never silent.
  env._Unwind_Resume = () => abort('unwind', '', 0, '_Unwind_Resume');
  env._d_delThrowable = () => {};
  env.__cxa_begin_catch = (ptr) => ptr;
  env.__cxa_end_catch = () => {};
  env.__cxa_rethrow = () => abort('exception', '', 0, '__cxa_rethrow');

  return env;
}
